settings.title: Settings
settings.jogHint: Press and hold longer than {ms} ms for continuous motion. 1%–100% speed maps linearly to {linMin}–{linMax} mm/s linear, {angMin}–{tcpAngMax} °/s orientation, and {angMin}–{jointAngMax} °/s joints.
settings.safetyHint: Boundary for {model} (stored per robot model). Jog, Home and Align stop at it. TCP limits are in the base frame; leave empty for unbounded. Joint limits are clamped inside the model limits.
